description:
اهلا نحن فريق طلابي يضم أعضاءً من مراحل أكاديمية مختلفة، فمنّا من تخرّج، ومنّا من لا يزال في دراسته. يجمعنا شغف مشترك بالعلوم والتكنولوجيا والابتكار.

نفخر بمشاركتنا في NASA Space Apps Challenge، ونعتبرها فرصة مميزة للتعلم، وتطوير مهاراتنا، والعمل على أفكار جديدة ضمن تحدٍ عالمي.

نسعى من خلال هذه المشاركة إلى اكتساب خبرات جديدة وتقديم عمل يعكس شغفنا وطموحنا.

We are a student team with members at different stages of their studies. Some of us have graduated, while others are still studying. What brings us together is our shared passion for science, technology, and innovation.

We are proud to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge and see it as a great opportunity to learn, develop our skills, and work together on creative solutions to real-world challenges.

Through this experience, we hope to gain valuable knowledge, strengthen our teamwork and problem-solving skills, and create a project that reflects our passion and ambition.
summary:
Our project aims to help school students of all ages easily access information about retired space devices and rovers that are no longer operational. We have focused on two main destinations: Mars and the Moon, dividing the project into three key missions for each.
• For Mars: The project presents a summary video and essential information about three rovers that traveled to the Red Planet and have since completed their missions and stopped operating.
• For the Moon: The project highlights three major lunar missions that are no longer active, yet we continue to benefit from their discoveries and data to this day.
We hope that our project and teamwork will be useful and inspiring for future generations, encouraging them to advance and learn. Our goal is to provide valuable information in an engaging way that leaves no room for boredom.
Thank you
details:
Project Idea and How It Works:
Our project focuses on presenting space information and making it easily accessible by dividing the project into two main sections: Mars and the Moon. The first section is dedicated to Mars, designed as a series of videos showcasing famous Mars exploration missions (Spirit & Opportunity, Sojourner, and Viking 1 & 2) in an engaging visual style. The second section focuses on the Moon, presented as a digital PDF file written in a clear storytelling format that documents key lunar landing missions.
Benefits and Expected Impact:
The project aims to simplify space science and the history of exploration missions for students and space enthusiasts. It transforms complex scientific data into enjoyable visual and narrative content that is easy to understand and access anytime.
Tools and Software Used:
Our team relied on Artificial Intelligence tools to draft scripts and simplify content, alongside video editing software such as CapCut to produce the Mars videos and combine footage with sound effects. We also utilized video clips and background music from YouTube, in addition to designing and formatting the Moon PDF file with illustrative images.
Creativity:
The creative aspect lies in combining two different presentation formats within a single project (visual videos for Mars and an illustrated narrative file for the Moon). This variety prevents boredom and caters to different learning and viewing preferences.
Factors Considered by the Team:
Our team ensured clear task distribution among members to maintain high production quality. We also prioritized scientific accuracy by relying on official NASA sources, and respected intellectual property rights when selecting footage and background music
